title: Stash local changes, pull from the remote and bring the changes back
summary: Puts your unfinished edits aside, downloads the newest commits from the remote while keeping your history tidy, and then puts your edits back on top. Use it when git pull refuses to run because local changes would be overwritten.

aliases.text: git pull fails local changes would be overwritten
save changes, pull and restore in git
git pull rebase with uncommitted changes
git update branch with local edits stashed

steps.explain: Preview: list the changed files that will be stashed. M means modified, ?? means a new untracked file. Untracked files are not stashed by default and stay in place.
steps.expect: Lines such as: M notes.txt. The stash list shows older stashes, if any.

steps.explain: Save the changes in the stash. They are removed from the working folder and kept in the stash list.
steps.expect: Saved working directory and index state On <branch>: wip before pull

steps.explain: Download the newest commits from the remote and replay your local commits on top, if you have any.
steps.expect: Already up to date, or a list of the updated files and a Fast-forward line.

steps.explain: Put the saved changes back. If this reports a conflict, the stash is kept: fix the files, see the warning below.
steps.expect: The changed file names, then Dropped refs/stash@{0}, when the pop worked cleanly.

prerequisites: A git repository with a remote named origin
Know the branch name, for example main

rollback.explain: If the pop reports a conflict, the stash is kept. Edit the conflicted files, run git add on them, then git stash drop to remove the saved copy. Until then your edits remain in git stash list.

warnings: If git stash pop reports CONFLICT, the stash is not deleted. Resolve the files before running any other stash command.
Untracked new files are not stashed unless you add -u, and they can still block the pull.
Rebasing rewrites local commits that were not pushed. Do not use it on a branch that others build on without checking first.
